headline: Wall Street Sell-Off Triggered by AI Investment Fears and Political Shifts
summary: Fears that election shifts could slow the artificial intelligence investment boom sparked a sharp global stock sell-off, weighing heavily on technology equities and dragging down international markets.
why: Surging valuations in technology and artificial intelligence infrastructure have made global equity indices highly sensitive to shifts in sentiment and capital spending outlooks.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Broad equity sell-offs driven by tech sector concerns directly pull down major benchmark indices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Concerns over the sustainability of AI investments and political changes triggered a sharp sell-off in technology stocks, weighing on major indices.
